name: Sacubitril-Valsartan (Entresto)
mechanism: Neprilysin inhibitor + ARB - increases natriuretic peptides while blocking angiotensin II
dosing: Start 24/26mg or 49/51mg BD, target 97/103mg BD. Must stop ACEi 36h before starting
contraindications: Concurrent ACEi use, history of angioedema, severe hepatic impairment
interactions: ACEi (angioedema risk - 36h washout essential), potassium-sparing diuretics
monitoring: Blood pressure, U&Es, signs of angioedema
sideEffects: Hypotension, hyperkalaemia, renal impairment, angioedema, dizziness
pharmacokinetics: Sacubitril is prodrug converted to active LBQ657, valsartan absorbed intact
clinicalPearls: Superior to enalapril in heart failure. Must have 36h ACEi washout. Specialist initiation often required
indication: Chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)
